Name: Lumisteria Bundle Greenhouse
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
I like having a bigger greenhouse, especially on modded games, to fit all my fruit trees, flowers, powerful crops and cooking ingredients. I also like to have still a bit of choice to make. And I want to deserve getting bigger area! I also loves bundles.

So here is my own variation on the classic "bigger greenhouse" theme : a greenhouse that is starting with access to the initial greenhouse room, and allows you to unlock 3 different new rooms once you completed the related bundles.
Bundles themes are :
[spoiler]
regrowables crops
fruit basket
dishes
[/spoiler]

The two first bundles are immediately accessibles, the third one will require the first one to be completed as it's in the room you'll unlock.

Notes :
Not compatible with mods that changes the greenhouse map.
If you already have stuff in the greenhouse in the spots where the bundles should appear, the log will let you know. Remove the stuff temporarily, let the bundle spawn, complete it, and you can put whatever was here back again.
Each room has a different layout, what you'll put in it is based on your preference and playstyle (and list of mods :D )
